title: New-game screen: Eric or Carina, and the skill checks
caption: Start on the title now opens a New game screen: a portrait card each for Eric and Carina, Japanese skill checks on or off, then Start. Continue, saves and Days skip it.

sections.title: Desktop, 1366 x 860
sections.caption: Cards on the left, the choices beside them. The picked card is in full colour with a teal edge; arrows, Tab and Esc work.

images.caption: Pointer over the card that isn't picked

sections.title: Phone, 390 x 844
sections.caption: The cards side by side, the choices under them, Start along the bottom.

sections.title: After Start
sections.caption: Picking the protagonist the page isn't playing reloads it as them, and the day starts by itself.

images.caption: Carina on the train after Start
